name: Clarification reply arrives → stamp agent.run.clarification-resumed
description:
ADR-053 Phase 4b-2 PR-2 — the interactive-RESUME marker (half 1 of the 2-step marker, the mirror of pause rules 07/08). When a coordinator loop re-enters as a clarification REPLY (the operator answered the question rule 07/08 paused on), this stamps agent.run.clarification-resumed on the RUN entity via the subject override $entity.triple.agent.run.entity-id; rule 11 consumes the marker, transitions awaiting_approval→executing, and clears both clarification markers.

WHY a single rule (no 07/08-style anchor split): on resume the reply re-enters carrying the run anchor DIRECTLY — semstreams#256 (shipped beta.106) threads the run's RunID onto the reply TaskMessage (HTTPMessageRequest.run_id → UserMessage.RunID → TaskMessage.RunID), so graph_writer stamps agent.run.entity-id on the reply loop regardless of which anchor branch the original ask used. So unlike the pause markers (which split because some recovery coordinators carry only lineage), the resume marker keys on agent.run.entity-id alone.

THE REPLY DISCRIMINATOR (agent.loop.reply-to ne ""): a loop-local signal that distinguishes a clarification reply from any other coordinator loop in the run (every run coordinator carries agent.run.entity-id, so the anchor alone is NOT enough). semstreams#256 Thread 2 shipped the TYPED shape in beta.106 (PR #261): the reply client sets in_reply_to (the asking loop-id) on the HTTPMessageRequest → TaskMessage.InReplyTo → graph_writer's buildSpawnIdentityTriples stamps a first-class agent.loop.reply-to triple (a 6-part loop entity reference, mirroring agent.loop.parent / agvocab.LoopReplyTo) on the reply loop. The maintainer DELIBERATELY chose the typed predicate over a third overload of the lineage.* namespace — so the lineage-namespace-abuse caveat that the earlier draft carried is GONE (no [[lineage-passthrough-pattern]] consumer added here).

ACTIVE on beta.106 (no longer inert): both trigger triples (agent.run.entity-id from RunID, agent.loop.reply-to from InReplyTo) are stamped at SPAWN time by buildSpawnIdentityTriples whenever a reply carries run_id + in_reply_to — independent of the LLM response — so this rule fires the moment the resumed coordinator loop is created. The behavioral mock journey (clarification-resume) drives the REAL reply path: it POSTs the answer to the dispatch /message endpoint with run_id + in_reply_to read from the paused run's triples (the same direct-API pattern tool-approval-gate uses; no seeding, no triple-write seam needed). NOTE: a production human-facing UI affordance that posts these fields is a SEPARATE follow-up slice (B2) — beta.106 + this rule make the wire support and the run-phase resume live; the journey exercises it end-to-end. Also pinned STRUCTURALLY by the agent_run_pack contract tests (resume marker + ordered marker-clear + the rule-09 bounce guard).

metadata.joins_with: 11-resume-awaiting-to-executing.json (consumes the marker + transitions + clears) and 07/08 (the pause markers this resumes).
metadata.marker_object: $entity.instance records WHICH loop carried the reply (mirrors 07/08's clarification_pending=$entity.instance).
metadata.single_rule_no_split: Keys on agent.run.entity-id alone — semstreams#256 (beta.106) threads the run anchor onto the reply, so the reply loop always carries agent.run.entity-id regardless of the original ask's anchor branch. Unlike the pause-marker pair 07/08.
metadata.reply_discriminator: agent.loop.reply-to — the TYPED semstreams#256 Thread-2 shape shipped in beta.106 (PR #261, agvocab.LoopReplyTo). The reply client sets in_reply_to → TaskMessage.InReplyTo → buildSpawnIdentityTriples stamps a 6-part loop entity ref. The maintainer chose this over a 3rd lineage.* overload, so no [[lineage-passthrough-pattern]] consumer is added here.
metadata.active_since: semstreams beta.106 (PR #261). The reply path now threads both run_id (→ agent.run.entity-id) and in_reply_to (→ agent.loop.reply-to); buildSpawnIdentityTriples stamps both at spawn, so this rule fires on any reply that carries them. Exercised end-to-end by the clarification-resume mock journey (drives the real dispatch /message reply path; no seeding). A production human-facing reply affordance is a separate UI follow-up. Also pinned structurally by the agent_run_pack contract tests.
metadata.autonomous_inertness: 4b-2 is interactive-only by construction (the pause it resumes never happens in autonomous mode — decide(ask_user) is rejected pre-stamp under restricted_decide_actions). No separate gate needed.
